content: The AI device OpenAI is developing with former Apple designer Jony Ive is “essentially a smart speaker without a display” that’s battery-powered, doughnut-shaped and roughly the size of a hockey puck, according to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman. The device, expected to launch in 2027 for a price over $300,  reportedly “will have a unique look, complete with moving parts,” including some that will move on their own to show when the device is responding or interacting with the user, along with lights, a camera system, and other sensors. Gurman’s sources also say the “battery-powered” device is designed to be “easy to carry around the home with one hand,”similar to Amazon’s now-discontinued Tap speaker. Gurman says it will “work similarly to the company’s ChatGPT voice mode on smartphone apps, but with more advanced models for humanlike interactivity” but look and feel nothing like an Apple product — despite their ongoing lawsuit. The speaker / pocket personal assistant could be the first in a “family of devices” OpenAI has planned, but we’ll probably hear a lot more about all of them before it eventually arrives.

chineseContent: 据彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 报道，OpenAI 与前苹果设计师 Jony Ive 共同开发的人工智能设备“本质上是一款没有显示屏的智能扬声器”，由电池供电，呈甜甜圈形状，大小与冰球差不多。该设备预计将于 2027 年推出，价格超过 300 美元，据报道“将具有独特的外观，配有可移动部件”，其中一些部件会自行移动，以显示设备何时响应或与用户交互，以及灯光、摄像头系统和其他传感器。古尔曼的消息人士还表示，这款“电池供电”设备的设计目的是“方便用一只手在家里携带”，类似于亚马逊现已停产的 Tap 扬声器。古尔曼表示，它将“与该公司在智能手机应用程序上的 ChatGPT 语音模式类似，但具有更先进的人类交互模型”，但外观和感觉与苹果产品完全不同——尽管他们正在进行诉讼。扬声器/袖珍个人助理可能是 OpenAI 计划的“设备系列”中的第一个，但在它最终到来之前我们可能会听到更多关于它们的信息。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
